questions_to_ask_seller: Can we run a battery report via Windows PowerShell to verify the exact design capacity vs full charge capacity?
Is the laptop still running on the factory thermal paste, and has it ever been opened for cleaning?
in_person_checks: Type every single key on the keyboard and test the keyboard backlight
Check trackpad responsiveness and palm rejection
Verify screen uniformity and test for dead pixels by opening a solid white/grey image
Check system properties to confirm Intel i7-13620H, 16GB RAM, and RTX 2050 match claims
Run a quick benchmark or stress test to check fan noise and thermals
negotiation_leverage: Warranty is already expired and battery health is at 87%
Sticker applied to the palmrest could leave a residue if removed
walk_away_if: The actual hardware specs in Windows do not match the listing
The laptop shows signs of liquid damage or unexpected internal repairs
The seller refuses an in-person test or basic software verification

verdict.one_liner: A well-maintained mid-range gaming laptop with complete accessories and transparent disclosures.
verdict.reasoning: The seller provides complete and transparent details, including realistic wear such as 87% battery health after a year of use. The inclusion of the original box and charger adds significant value and credibility. Photos confirm a clean physical exterior with no major structural defects. While thermal performance and internal components require an in-person check, the overall listing is solid and fairly priced for the local market.
verdict.ideal_for: Gamers and students looking for a capable mid-range gaming and productivity laptop with verified box and charger.
verdict.not_ideal_for: Users needing a brand-new device with active manufacturer warranty.
